2607.03447.title: TRIAGE: Trustworthy Retrieval Instrumentation And Graph Evaluation
2607.03447.paper_summary: Knowledge graphs (KGs) that underpin Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Graph-RAG) are increasingly built automatically by LLM-driven extraction rather than curated by experts. Proper evaluation would require instrumenting all pertinent stages: extraction, graph construction, and inference, coherently enough to localize failures, so that a failure at one stage is not discovered as a wrong answer at the end. We introduce TRIAGE, a stage-aware instrumentation framework for automated, document-grounded graph-RAG that asks not only whether the underlying graph can be trusted but at what cost it can be queried. TRIAGE attaches stage-specific, independently interpretable metrics to three stages: the KG Implementation (triple confidence, source coverage, and schema and canonicalization checks), the KG Validation by expert (graph-level structural quality, with correctness and completeness computed only as offline calibration when a reference is available), and the KG Usage (retrieval coverage, faithfulness, and retrieval cost); the deployed metrics need no gold annotations, the gold-requiring ones serving only as offline calibration. At usage time these metrics form a diagnostic chain of necessary conditions whose first broken link localizes the failure, and the diagnosis maps to the stage levers that can remedy it: extraction, graph and schema, or retrieval. TRIAGE is a theoretical framework with a proof of concept and a reproducible evaluation protocol.
2607.03447.paper_summary_zh: 知識圖譜 (KGs) 作為基於圖的檢索增強生成 (Graph-RAG) 的基礎，越來越多地是通過大型語言模型 (LLM) 驅動的自動提取來構建，而不是由專家精心策劃。適當的評估需要對所有相關階段進行儀器化：提取、圖構建和推理，足夠一致地定位失敗，以便在某一階段的失敗不會在最後被發現為錯誤答案。我們介紹了 TRIAGE，一個階段感知的儀器化框架，用於自動化的、基於文檔的圖-RAG，該框架不僅詢問底層圖是否可以被信任，還詢問查詢的成本。TRIAGE 將階段特定的、獨立可解釋的指標附加到三個階段：KG 實施（三元組信心、來源覆蓋和模式及標準化檢查）、KG 由專家驗證（圖層級結構質量，正確性和完整性僅在有參考時作為離線校準計算），以及 KG 使用（檢索覆蓋、忠實性和檢索成本）；部署的指標不需要黃金標註，僅需要黃金標註的指標作為離線校準。在使用時，這些指標形成了一個必要條件的診斷鏈，其第一個斷裂鏈接定位失敗，而診斷映射到可以修正的階段杠杆：提取、圖和模式或檢索。TRIAGE 是一個理論框架，具有概念驗證和可重複的評估協議。
